	public static DoubleValue GetDefault(UnitClassEnum unitClass, string rateType)
	{
		string unitClassKey = UOM.GetUnitClassKey(unitClass, rateType);
		if (HYSYSUOM == null || !HYSYSUOM.ContainsKey(unitClassKey))
		{
			return null;
		}
		DoubleValue result = null;
		foreach (HYSYSUOMCoef item in HYSYSUOM[unitClassKey])
		{
			if (item.IsDefault)
			{
				result = new DoubleValue(item.UnitKey, item.Coefficient);
				break;
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	public static DoubleValue GetDefault(UnitClassEnum unitClass)
	{
		return GetDefault(unitClass, string.Empty);
	}

	public static DoubleValue GetUnitCoefficient(UnitClassEnum unitClass, string unitKey, string rateType, out double offsetValue)
	{
		offsetValue = 0.0;
		string unitClassKey = UOM.GetUnitClassKey(unitClass, rateType);
		if (HYSYSUOM == null || !HYSYSUOM.ContainsKey(unitClassKey))
		{
			return null;
		}
		offsetValue = GetOffSetValue(unitClass, unitKey);
		DoubleValue result = null;
		foreach (HYSYSUOMCoef item in HYSYSUOM[unitClassKey])
		{
			if (item.UnitKey.ToUpper().Trim() == unitKey.ToUpper().Trim())
			{
				result = new DoubleValue(item.UnitKey.Trim(), item.Coefficient);
				break;
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	public static DoubleValue GetUnitCoefficient(UnitClassEnum unitClass, string unitKey, out double offsetValue)
	{
		return GetUnitCoefficient(unitClass, unitKey, string.Empty, out offsetValue);
	}

	private static double GetOffSetValue(UnitClassEnum unitClass, string unitKey)
	{
		double result = 0.0;
		if (unitClass == UnitClassEnum.Pressure && HYSYSPressureOffsetDic.ContainsKey(unitKey.Trim()))
		{
			result = HYSYSPressureOffsetDic[unitKey.Trim()];
		}
		return result;
	}

	public static DoubleValue GetConvertedValue(UnitClassEnum unitClass, DoubleValue val, string destinationUnitKey, string rateType)
	{
		if (HYSYSUOM == null || val == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(val.Unit) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(destinationUnitKey))
		{
			return val;
		}
		double offsetValue;
		DoubleValue unitCoefficient = GetUnitCoefficient(unitClass, val.Unit, rateType, out offsetValue);
		double offsetValue2;
		DoubleValue unitCoefficient2 = GetUnitCoefficient(unitClass, destinationUnitKey, rateType, out offsetValue2);
		if (unitCoefficient == null || unitCoefficient2 == null)
		{
			return val;
		}
		DoubleValue doubleValue = new DoubleValue();
		doubleValue.Unit = destinationUnitKey;
		if (unitClass == UnitClassEnum.Temperature)
		{
			doubleValue.Value = GetTempConvertedValue(val.Value, val.Unit, destinationUnitKey);
		}
		else
		{
			doubleValue.Value = (val.Value - offsetValue) * unitCoefficient2.Value / unitCoefficient.Value + offsetValue2;
		}
		return doubleValue;
	}

	public static double GetTempConvertedValue(double valuein, string souceUnitKey, string destinationUnitKey)
	{
		double result = valuein;
		if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(souceUnitKey) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(destinationUnitKey))
		{
			return valuein;
		}
		if (souceUnitKey == "R" && destinationUnitKey == "C")
		{
			result = (valuein - 491.67) * 5.0 / 9.0;
		}
		else if (souceUnitKey == "R" && destinationUnitKey == "F")
		{
			result = valuein - 459.67;
		}
		else if (souceUnitKey == "R" && destinationUnitKey == "K")
		{
			result = valuein * 5.0 / 9.0;
		}
		else if (souceUnitKey == "C" && destinationUnitKey == "R")
		{
			result = valuein * 1.8 + 491.67;
		}
		else if (souceUnitKey == "C" && destinationUnitKey == "F")
		{
			result = valuein * 1.8 + 32.0;
		}
		else if (souceUnitKey == "C" && destinationUnitKey == "K")
		{
			result = valuein + 273.15;
		}
		else if (souceUnitKey == "F" && destinationUnitKey == "R")
		{
			result = valuein + 459.67;
		}
		else if (souceUnitKey == "F" && destinationUnitKey == "C")
		{
			result = (valuein - 32.0) * 5.0 / 9.0;
		}
		else if (souceUnitKey == "F" && destinationUnitKey == "K")
		{
			result = (valuein + 459.67) * 5.0 / 9.0;
		}
		else if (souceUnitKey == "K" && destinationUnitKey == "C")
		{
			result = valuein - 273.15;
		}
		else if (souceUnitKey == "K" && destinationUnitKey == "R")
		{
			result = valuein * 1.8;
		}
		else if (souceUnitKey == "K" && destinationUnitKey == "F")
		{
			result = valuein * 1.8 - 459.67;
		}
		return result;
	}

	public static DoubleValue GetConvertedValue(UnitClassEnum unitClass, DoubleValue val, string destinationUnitKey)
	{
		return GetConvertedValue(unitClass, val, destinationUnitKey, string.Empty);
	}

	public static DoubleValue GetConvertedValueToDefaultKey(UnitClassEnum unitClass, DoubleValue val)
	{
		return GetConvertedValue(unitClass, val, GetDefault(unitClass).Unit);
	}

	public static DoubleValue GetConvertedValue(UnitClassEnum unitClass, double val, string sourceUnitKey, string destinationUnitKey)
	{
		return GetConvertedValue(unitClass, new DoubleValue(sourceUnitKey, val), destinationUnitKey, string.Empty);
	}
}

public class P2ComponentMap
{
	private Hashtable m_hashMap1 = new Hashtable();

	private Hashtable m_hashMap2 = new Hashtable();

	private Hashtable m_hashMap3 = new Hashtable();

	private Hashtable m_hashMap4 = new Hashtable();

	private Hashtable m_hashMap5 = new Hashtable();

	private Hashtable m_hashMap6 = new Hashtable();

	private Hashtable m_hashMap_Fomula = new Hashtable();

	private List<string> removedComp = new List<string>();

	private UserCompoent userComp = new UserCompoent();

	public void Add(P2Component p2, AspenComponent aspen, HYSYSComponent hysys)
	{
		p2.m_apsenComp = aspen;
		p2.m_hysysComp = hysys;
		if (p2.ID1.Length > 0)
		{
			m_hashMap1[p2.ID1] = p2;
		}
		if (p2.ID2.Length > 0)
		{
			m_hashMap2[p2.ID2] = p2;
		}
		if (p2.ID3.Length > 0)
		{
			m_hashMap3[p2.ID3] = p2;
		}
		if (p2.ID4.Length > 0)
		{
			m_hashMap4[p2.ID4] = p2;
		}
		if (p2.ID5.Length > 0)
		{
			m_hashMap5[p2.ID5] = p2;
		}
		if (p2.Name.Length > 0)
		{
			m_hashMap6[p2.Name.ToUpper()] = p2;
		}
		if (m_hashMap_Fomula.Contains(p2.Formula))
		{
			m_hashMap_Fomula.Remove(p2.Formula);
			removedComp.Add(p2.Formula);
		}
		else if (!removedComp.Contains(p2.Formula))
		{
			m_hashMap_Fomula[p2.Formula] = p2;
		}
	}

	private P2Component GetP2CompFromUserComp(string strP2)
	{
		if (m_hashMap1[strP2] is P2Component result)
		{
			return result;
		}
		if (m_hashMap2[strP2] is P2Component result2)
		{
			return result2;
		}
		if (m_hashMap3[strP2] is P2Component result3)
		{
			return result3;
		}
		if (m_hashMap4[strP2] is P2Component result4)
		{
			return result4;
		}
		if (m_hashMap5[strP2] is P2Component result5)
		{
			return result5;
		}
		if (m_hashMap6[strP2] is P2Component result6)
		{
			return result6;
		}
		if (m_hashMap_Fomula[strP2] is P2Component result7)
		{
			return result7;
		}
		return null;
	}

	public P2Component GetP2Component(string strP2)
	{
		if (m_hashMap1[strP2] is P2Component result)
		{
			return result;
		}
		if (m_hashMap2[strP2] is P2Component result2)
		{
			return result2;
		}
		if (m_hashMap3[strP2] is P2Component result3)
		{
			return result3;
		}
		if (m_hashMap4[strP2] is P2Component result4)
		{
			return result4;
		}
		if (m_hashMap5[strP2] is P2Component result5)
		{
			return result5;
		}
		if (m_hashMap6[strP2] is P2Component result6)
		{
			return result6;
		}
		if (m_hashMap_Fomula[strP2] is P2Component result7)
		{
			return result7;
		}
		P2Component p2CompFromUserComp = GetP2CompFromUserComp(userComp.GetP2V83Key(strP2));
		if (p2CompFromUserComp != null)
		{
			return p2CompFromUserComp;
		}
		return null;
	}
}

public class AssayUserProperty
{
	public string Description { get; set; }

	public string Qualifier { get; set; }

	public string DefaultUnit { get; set; }

	public string HYSYSKey { get; set; }

	public AssayUserProperty(string description, string qualifier, string defaultUnit, string hysysKey)
	{
		DefaultUnit = description;
		Qualifier = qualifier;
		DefaultUnit = defaultUnit;
		HYSYSKey = hysysKey;
	}
}
public class P2ToHYSYSThomoMap
{
	private static Dictionary<string, string> hysysDic;

	public static List<P2ToHysysMapItem> MapData { get; private set; }

	public static Dictionary<string, string> ActivityProperties { get; set; }

	public static Dictionary<string, string> HYSYSActivityProperties { get; set; }

	public static List<string> EnthalpyThermoList { get; private set; }

	public static List<string> DensityThermoList { get; private set; }

	static P2ToHYSYSThomoMap()
	{
		SetP2ToHysysThomoMap();
		SetEnthalpyThermoList();
		SetDensityThermoListt();
		SetActivityProperties();
	}

	public static string GetHysysPropertyKey(string p2Key, string p2PropertyName)
	{
		string empty = string.Empty;
		if (MapData != null && MapData.Count > 0)
		{
			foreach (P2ToHysysMapItem mapDatum in MapData)
			{
				if (p2Key == mapDatum.P2Keyword && mapDatum.P2ThomoKey.StartsWith(p2PropertyName.ToUpper()))
				{
					return mapDatum.HysysThomoKey;
				}
			}
		}
		return empty;
	}

	private static void SetP2ToHysysThomoMap()

public class P2ToHysysMapItem
{
	public string P2Keyword { get; private set; }

	public string P2ThomoKey { get; private set; }

	public string HysysThomoKey { get; private set; }

	public string HysysThomoName { get; private set; }

	public P2ToHysysMapItem(string p2Keyword, string p2ThomoKey, string hysysThomoName, string hysysThomoKey)
	{
		P2Keyword = p2Keyword;
		P2ThomoKey = p2ThomoKey;
		HysysThomoName = hysysThomoName;
		HysysThomoKey = hysysThomoKey;
	}
}

}
public class UserCompoent
{
	public class NotConvertedComp
	{
		public string Pro2Key { get; set; }

		public string Pro2KeyV83 { get; set; }

		public double MW { get; set; }

		public DoubleValue NBP { get; set; }

		public DoubleValue Density { get; set; }

		public bool NeedCheck { get; set; }
	}

	private readonly string C_Microsoft_Jet_OLEDB_Provider = "Provider=Microsoft.Jet.OLEDB.4.0;Data Source=";

	private readonly string C_Can_not_find_the_file = "Can not find the file: ";

	private readonly string C_Pro2Key = "Pro2Key";

	private readonly string C_Pro2KeyV83 = "Pro2KeyV83";

	private readonly string C_MW = "MW";

	private readonly string C_NBP = "NBP";

	private readonly string C_NBPUnit = "NBPUnit";

	private readonly string C_Density = "Density";

	private readonly string C_DensityUnit = "DensityUnit";

	private readonly string C_NeedCheck = "NeedCheck";

	private readonly string C_AddedDate = "AddedDate";

	private string pathName;

	private string strSelect;

	public List<NotConvertedComp> UserCompMapLib { get; private set; }

	public List<NotConvertedComp> UserCompMapNoLib { get; private set; }

	public List<string> NotConvertedComps { get; set; }

	public List<NotConvertedComp> AvailableComp { get; set; }

	public List<string> Notes { get; set; }

	public List<string> AvailableCompNames
	{
		get
		{
			if (AvailableComp != null)
			{
				List<string> list = new List<string>();
				{
					foreach (NotConvertedComp item in AvailableComp)
					{
						list.Add(item.Pro2Key);
					}
					return list;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public string GetP2V83Key(string key)
	{
		string result = string.Empty;
		foreach (NotConvertedComp item in UserCompMapLib)
		{
			if (item.Pro2Key == key)
			{
				result = item.Pro2KeyV83;
				break;
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	public NotConvertedComp GetP2UserComp(string key)
	{
		NotConvertedComp result = null;
		foreach (NotConvertedComp item in UserCompMapLib)
		{
			if (item.Pro2Key == key)
			{
				result = item;
				break;
			}
		}
		return result;
	}

	public UserCompoent()
	{
		UserCompMapLib = new List<NotConvertedComp>();
		UserCompMapNoLib = new List<NotConvertedComp>();
		AvailableComp = new List<NotConvertedComp>();
		NotConvertedComps = new List<string>();
		Notes = new List<string>();
		string applicationFolder = BaseObject.ApplicationFolder;
		pathName = applicationFolder + "\\UserComponet.mdb";
		if (!File.Exists(pathName))
		{
			return;
		}
		ReadData();
		if (AvailableComp.Count <= 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		foreach (NotConvertedComp item in AvailableComp)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(item.Pro2KeyV83))
			{
				UserCompMapLib.Add(item);
			}
			else if (item.MW != 0.0 && item.NBP != null && item.Density != null)
			{
				UserCompMapNoLib.Add(item);
			}
		}
	}

	private void ReadData()
	{
		strSelect = "SELECT * FROM UserComponent";
		DataSet dataSet = GetDataSet(pathName, strSelect);
		if (dataSet == null || dataSet.Tables == null || dataSet.Tables.Count == 0 || (dataSet.Tables[0].Rows == null && dataSet.Tables[0].Rows.Count == 0))
		{
			return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < dataSet.Tables[0].Rows.Count; i++)
		{
			NotConvertedComp notConvertedComp = new NotConvertedComp();
			DataRow dataRow = dataSet.Tables[0].Rows[i];
			if (dataRow == null)
			{
				continue;
			}
			if (dataRow[C_Pro2Key] != null)
			{
				notConvertedComp.Pro2Key = dataRow[C_Pro2Key].ToString();
			}
			if (dataRow[C_Pro2KeyV83] != null)
			{
				notConvertedComp.Pro2KeyV83 = dataRow[C_Pro2KeyV83].ToString();
			}
			if (dataRow[C_MW] != null)
			{
				string text = dataRow[C_MW].ToString().Trim();
				double result = 0.0;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))
				{
					double.TryParse(text, out result);
					notConvertedComp.MW = result;
				}
			}
			if (dataRow[C_NBP] != null)
			{
				string text2 = dataRow[C_NBP].ToString().Trim();
				double result2 = 0.0;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
				{
					double.TryParse(text2, out result2);
					if (dataRow[C_NBPUnit] != null)
					{
						notConvertedComp.NBP = new DoubleValue(dataRow[C_NBPUnit].ToString().Trim(), result2);
					}
				}
			}
			if (dataRow[C_Density] != null)
			{
				string text3 = dataRow[C_Density].ToString().Trim();
				double result3 = 0.0;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text3))
				{
					double.TryParse(text3, out result3);
					if (dataRow[C_DensityUnit] != null)
					{
						notConvertedComp.Density = new DoubleValue(dataRow[C_DensityUnit].ToString().Trim(), result3);
					}
				}
			}
			if (dataRow[C_NeedCheck] != null)
			{
				notConvertedComp.NeedCheck = dataRow[C_Pro2KeyV83].ToString() == "1";
			}
			AvailableComp.Add(notConvertedComp);
		}
	}

	public void WriteData(string fileName)
	{
		if (File.Exists(pathName))
		{
			new FileInfo(pathName).IsReadOnly = false;
			UpdateUserComponentTable();
			SaveConverterMessage(fileName);
		}
	}

	public void UpdateUserComponentTable()
	{
		strSelect = "SELECT * FROM UserComponent";
		OleDbConnection oleDbConnection = null;
		DataSet dataSet = new DataSet();
		try
		{
			OleDbCommand oleDbCommand = new OleDbCommand(strSelect);
			oleDbConnection = OpenConnection(pathName);
			if (oleDbConnection == null || oleDbConnection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				return;
			}
			oleDbCommand.Connection = oleDbConnection;
			if (oleDbCommand.Connection == null || oleDbCommand.Connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				return;
			}
			OleDbDataAdapter oleDbDataAdapter = new OleDbDataAdapter(oleDbCommand);
			OleDbCommandBuilder oleDbCommandBuilder = new OleDbCommandBuilder(oleDbDataAdapter);
			oleDbDataAdapter.Fill(dataSet);
			if (dataSet == null || dataSet.Tables == null || dataSet.Tables.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dataSet.Tables[0].Rows != null && dataSet.Tables[0].Rows.Count != 0)
			{
				foreach (DataRow row in dataSet.Tables[0].Rows)
				{
					row[C_NeedCheck] = true;
					foreach (NotConvertedComp item in UserCompMapLib)
					{
						if (item.Pro2Key == row[C_Pro2Key].ToString().Trim())
						{
							row[C_NeedCheck] = false;
							break;
						}
					}
					foreach (NotConvertedComp item2 in UserCompMapNoLib)
					{
						if (item2.Pro2Key == row[C_Pro2Key].ToString().Trim())
						{
							row[C_NeedCheck] = false;
							break;
						}
					}
					foreach (string note in Notes)
					{
						if (note == row[C_Pro2Key].ToString().Trim())
						{
							row[C_NeedCheck] = true;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (string notConvertedComp in NotConvertedComps)
			{
				string strMessage = string.Format(P2Globalization.GetString("NotConvertedComps"), notConvertedComp, pathName);
				DebugPrint.OutputDebugString(DebugLevel.BuildHYSYSObject, WarningLevel.Warning, strMessage);
				bool flag = true;
				foreach (NotConvertedComp item3 in AvailableComp)
				{
					if (notConvertedComp == item3.Pro2Key)
					{
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					DataRow dataRow2 = dataSet.Tables[0].NewRow();
					dataRow2[C_NeedCheck] = true;
					dataRow2[C_Pro2Key] = notConvertedComp;
					dataRow2[C_DensityUnit] = "KG/M3";
					dataRow2[C_NBPUnit] = "C";
					dataRow2[C_AddedDate] = DateTime.Now;
					dataSet.Tables[0].Rows.Add(dataRow2);
				}
			}
			oleDbCommandBuilder.GetInsertCommand();
			oleDbDataAdapter.Update(dataSet);
		}
		catch
		{
		}
		finally
		{
			if (oleDbConnection != null && oleDbConnection.State != ConnectionState.Closed)
			{
				oleDbConnection.Close();
			}
		}
	}

	private void SaveConverterMessage(string fileName)
	{
		strSelect = "SELECT *  FROM ConvertNotes";
		OleDbConnection oleDbConnection = null;
		DataSet dataSet = new DataSet();
		try
		{
			OleDbCommand oleDbCommand = new OleDbCommand(strSelect);
			oleDbConnection = OpenConnection(pathName);
			if (oleDbConnection == null || oleDbConnection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				return;
			}
			oleDbCommand.Connection = oleDbConnection;
			if (oleDbCommand.Connection == null || oleDbCommand.Connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
			{
				return;
			}
			OleDbDataAdapter oleDbDataAdapter = new OleDbDataAdapter(oleDbCommand);
			new OleDbCommandBuilder(oleDbDataAdapter);
			oleDbDataAdapter.Fill(dataSet, "ConvertNotes");
			if (dataSet == null || dataSet.Tables == null || dataSet.Tables.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			new OleDbCommand("Delete  From [ConvertNotes]", oleDbConnection).ExecuteNonQuery();
			foreach (string note in Notes)
			{
				new OleDbCommand($"INSERT INTO [ConvertNotes] ([IDNumber], [FileName], [DateAndTime],[Note]) VALUES ({++num}, '{fileName}', '{DateTime.Now}','{note}')", oleDbConnection).ExecuteNonQuery();
			}
		}
		catch
		{
		}
		finally
		{
			if (oleDbConnection != null && oleDbConnection.State != ConnectionState.Closed)
			{
				oleDbConnection.Close();
			}
		}
	}

	private DataSet GetDataSet(string sDatabasePahtAndName, string strSQL)
	{
		DataSet dataSet = new DataSet();
		OleDbCommand oleDbCommand = new OleDbCommand(strSQL);
		OleDbConnection oleDbConnection = OpenConnection(sDatabasePahtAndName);
		if (oleDbConnection == null || oleDbConnection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
		{
			return null;
		}
		oleDbCommand.Connection = oleDbConnection;
		if (oleDbCommand.Connection == null || oleDbCommand.Connection.State != ConnectionState.Open)
		{
			return null;
		}
		OleDbDataAdapter oleDbDataAdapter = new OleDbDataAdapter(oleDbCommand);
		try
		{
			oleDbDataAdapter.Fill(dataSet);
		}
		catch
		{
			dataSet = null;
		}
		CloseConnection(oleDbConnection);
		return dataSet;
	}

	private OleDbConnection OpenConnection(string dbName)
	{
		if (!File.Exists(dbName))
		{
			_ = C_Can_not_find_the_file + dbName;
			return null;
		}
		OleDbConnection oleDbConnection = new OleDbConnection(C_Microsoft_Jet_OLEDB_Provider + dbName);
		try
		{
			oleDbConnection.Open();
			return oleDbConnection;
		}
		catch
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

	private void CloseConnection(OleDbConnection connection)
	{
		if (connection != null && connection.State != ConnectionState.Closed)
		{
			connection.Close();
		}
	}
}
